get.description: Gets all projects visible to current user

parameters.name: CanManageProjectMembers
parameters.description:
When true, returns only projects where the current user can manage project members.
When false, returns only projects where the current user cannot manage project members.
When null or omitted, this filter is not applied.

parameters.name: CustomFieldValue
parameters.description:
Leave empty to filter by custom field without a value.

For list-type custom fields: enter a comma-separated list of value IDs (e.g., '1' or '1,2,-1', where '-1' allows to filter list field with empty value).

parameters.name: CustomFieldExactMatch
parameters.description:
When true, text custom field filter (CustomFieldAlias + CustomFieldValue) is matched by exact equality instead of contains (substring).
When false or omitted, the custom field value is matched using contains (e.g. LIKE '%value%').

parameters.name: IncludePlainTextDescription
parameters.description:
The project has a `Description` attribute which is stored as HTML.

This parameter allows you to include an additional `PlainTextDescription` attribute that is plain text.

Pass `true` to include `PlainTextDescription`.

post.description:
Creates a new rates history record starting from the specified Effective Date.

- All later Rate History records for this user will be permanently deleted.

- All metrics for time logs dated on or after the Effective Date will be recalculated.

- For time entries already Billed or Invoiced, only Billable metrics (based on the external rate) will be recalculated.

requestBody.description: The rates model containing HourlyRate, HourlyRateInternal, and EffectiveDate
